title: Current compact Odds EV Arbs response

prices.description: For encoded boards, restore the field-name and value pools before validating the complete logical price and its captured references.

rows.description: Odds uses a compact reference index into prices; financial views retain full calculation rows.

price_field_pool.description: Exact repeated fields shared only within this frozen board. Restore each price field_refs before interpreting the price.

price_key_pool.description: Exact field names for wide boards. Decode numeric price keys and field_refs keys before expanding price_field_pool; quote_id, quote_revision and field_refs stay literal.

financial_field_pool.description: Frozen repeated financial row values. Restore financial_field_refs into each row before logical schema validation or financial price references.

price_object_keys.description: Exact one-level keys of every object-valued price field, after price_key_pool and price_field_pool expansion. Nested values remain literal. Decode before logical validation or aging.

native_contract_summary.description: Captured native wording, original predicate and explicit equality/scoring facts; id points to the complete locally retained contract evidence.
